Title: Heroes of the Storm Balance Patch Notes — February 19, 2026
Subtitle: [Heroes of the Storm Balance Patch Notes — February 19, 2026] We’ve just released a patch to the live servers in order to apply some balance and bug fixes. View Full Article
Highlights: [Heroes of the Storm Balance Patch Notes — February 19, 2026] We’ve just released a patch to the live servers in order to apply some balance and bug fixes. View Full Article
CleanedNotes:
=== Battlegrounds: Braxis Holdout ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue that caused terrain to be rendered incorrectly.

=== Battlegrounds: Hanamura Temple ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Sentinel Camps are now properly displayed with a Bruiser icon.
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing Sentinel Camps to spawn 30 seconds later than intended.

=== Heroes: Azmodan ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Level 4
    • Battleborn
      • Now properly reduces the cooldown of Demon Lieutenant.
  • Level 10
    • Black Pool
      • Now properly deals reduced damage to non-Heroes.

=== Heroes: Deathwing ===
[Updates]
  Base:
  • Incinerate [W]
    • Cooldown increased from 6 to 7 seconds.
  Talents:
  • Level 7
    • Death Drop
      • Duration of Spell Armor reduction decreased from 6 to 4 seconds.
[Bug Fixes]
  • Base
    • Form Swap
      • AI can no longer use the removed Form Swap Ability.

=== Heroes: Gul'dan ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Level 16
    • Ruinous Affliction
      • Fixed an issue that caused Ruinous Affliction to deal bonus damage on the 3rd and 5th hit, instead of the 3rd and 6th hit.

=== Heroes: Jaina ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Base
    • Frostbite [Trait]
      • Fixed an issue that caused Ice Block to not show the correct cooldown value in the tooltip.
      • Fixed an issue that caused Ice Cold to allow Jaina to move through pathing blockers and stationary targets.

=== Heroes: Muradin ===
[Updates]
  Base:
  • Storm Bolt [Q]
    • Quest requirements reduced from 50/200 to 40/160.
  Talents:
  • Level 1
    • Give 'Em The Axe
      • Bonus Damage reduced from 50% to 40%.
  • Level 4
    • Sledgehammer
      • Now also reduces the cooldown of Storm Bolt by 1.5 seconds.
  • Level 7
    • Perfect Storm
      • Internal cooldown reduced from 10 to 8.5 seconds.
      • Now also restores 25 Mana on reset.
  • Level 13
    • Healing Static
      • Heal per Hero hit increased from 5% to 6%.
[Bug Fixes]
  • Base
    • Dwarf Toss [E]
      • Fixed an issue that caused Dwarf Toss to go on cooldown when used on invalid terrain.
  • Level 1
    • Dwarf Block
      • Can no longer stack beyond 3 charges.

=== Heroes: Murky ===
[Updates]
  Base:
  • Spawn Egg [D]
    • Revive Shield duration increased from 10 to 15 seconds.
  Talents:
  • Level 10
    • March of the Murlocs
      • Cooldown reduced from 110 to 100 seconds.
  • Level 13
    • Egg Shell
      • Shield increased from 35% to 50% of Murky's Health.
      • Shield now lasts until destroyed.
  • Level 20
    • Changed the order of Murky's Level 20 Talents to be the same as other Heroes (Q, W, E, etc.)
    • Never-Ending March
      • Will now last a minimum of 7 seconds, even if stopped.
[Bug Fixes]
  • Base
    • Pufferfish [W]
      • Puffed Up will now display first in the Buff Bar.
      • Fixed an issue that caused Murky to lose his increased size after death.
    • Spawn Egg [D]
      • Fixed an issue that caused Murky to respawn faster than intended.
  • Level 1
    • Shell Game
      • Shell Game now shows the Trait button for the Talent, instead of an Active button.
  • Level 20
    • Faster Fish
      • Faster Fish now also causes the animation of the Pufferfish to play faster.
      • Faster Fish now shows the W button for the talent, instead of the Trait button.

=== Heroes: Rehgar ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Level 20
    • Elemental Conduit
      • Fixed an issue that caused Elemental Conduit's Shields to not refresh to 5 seconds.
      • Fixed an issue that caused Elemental Conduit's refresh to search for allies to give the Shield around the targets hit, instead of Rehgar's location.

=== Heroes: Sylvanas ===
[Updates]
  Talents:
  • Level 7
    • Lost Soul
      • Extra 10% damage bonus provided by Lost Soul has been removed.
[Bug Fixes]
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing the Duration Bar for Haunting Arrows to reference the incorrect string.

=== Heroes: Thrall ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Level 1
    • Echo of the Elements
      • Fixed an issue that caused Echo of the Elements bounces to bounce to cloaked targets.
  • Level 7
    • Rolling Thunder
      • Rolling Thunder damage now displays as a crit.
  • Level 16
    • Alpha Wolf
      • Alpha Wolf damage now displays as a crit.

=== Heroes: Tyrande ===
[Updates]
  Base:
  • Lunar Flare [E]
    • Mythic Reward requirements reduced from 45 to 40.

=== Heroes: Zagara ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Base
    • Infested Drop [E]
      • Fixed an issue that caused Roaches melee attacks to launch missiles instead of directly hitting.
      • Fixed an issue that caused Roaches to not display correctly in the Death Recap.
